local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root

local Global = (getgenv and getgenv()) or shared
local Name = "Axirian"
local floorConn = nil

pcall(function()
    if isfolder and not isfolder(Name.." Assets") then makefolder(Name.." Assets") end
end)

local function urlEncode(s)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    return (s:gsub("([^%w%-%_%.%~])", function(c)
        return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(c))
    end))
end

local function ensureAsset(filename)
    local path = Name.." Assets/"..filename
    if isfile and not isfile(path) then
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jskfhggjxu/Axirian-glicher-Assets/refs/heads/main/"..urlEncode(filename))
        end)
        if not ok or not data or #data < 100 then
            ok, data = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jskfhggjxu/Axirian-glicher-Assets/refs/heads/main/"..filename)
            end)
        end
        if ok and data and #data > 100 then
            writefile(path, data)
            repeat task.wait(0.05) until isfile(path)
        else
            warn("[Axirian] music missing: "..filename)
            return nil
        end
    end
    if getcustomasset then
        return getcustomasset(path)
    end
    return nil
end

local function hardCleanup()
    if floorConn then
        pcall(function() floorConn:Disconnect() end)
        floorConn = nil
    end
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if v.Name == "AxirianStandaloneCont" or v:GetAttribute("VFX") == true then
            pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    if Global.Cont then
        pcall(function() Global.Cont:Destroy() end)
        Global.Cont = nil
    end
    for _, n in ipairs({"AxirianStandaloneAudio", "AxirianClassicMusic"}) do
        local s = SoundService:FindFirstChild(n)
        if s then
            pcall(function()
                if s.Stop then s:Stop() end
                s:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function setupGlobalsAndAudio(musicKey, effectName)
    hardCleanup()
    task.wait(0.12)

    char = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or root
    head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
    torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root

    local cont = Instance.new("Folder")
    cont.Name = "AxirianStandaloneCont"
    cont.Parent = workspace

    local floorPart = Instance.new("Part")
    floorPart.Name = "Flooring"
    floorPart.Anchored = true
    floorPart.CanCollide = false
    floorPart.Transparency = 1
    floorPart.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    floorPart.Parent = cont

    local classicSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    classicSound.Name = "AxirianClassicMusic"
    classicSound.Looped = true
    classicSound.Volume = 2
    classicSound.Parent = SoundService

    local customId = ensureAsset(musicKey..".mp3")
    if customId then
        pcall(function()
            classicSound.SoundId = customId
            classicSound:Play()
        end)
    else
        warn("[Axirian] No music for "..effectName)
    end

    local LoudProxy = {}
    setmetatable(LoudProxy, {
        __index = function(_, k)
            if k == "PlaybackLoudness" then
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return classicSound.PlaybackLoudness end)
                if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v end
                return math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 8)) * 120 + math.random() * 40
            elseif k == "TimePosition" then
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return classicSound.TimePosition end)
                if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
                return 0
            elseif k == "TimeLength" then
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return classicSound.TimeLength end)
                if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
                return 0
            end
            return classicSound[k]
        end,
    })

    Global.Flooring = floorPart
    Global.Cont = cont
    Global.Loud = LoudProxy
    Global.im2 = nil
    Global.MusicPlayer = classicSound
    Global.rootpart1 = root
    Global.rootpart = root
    Global.head = head
    Global.torso = torso
    Global.insSet = function(obj, prop, val)
        pcall(function() obj[prop] = val end)
    end

    floorConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not cont.Parent then
            if floorConn then floorConn:Disconnect() floorConn = nil end
            return
        end
        local c = lp.Character
        if c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local r = c.HumanoidRootPart
            floorPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position.X, r.Position.Y - 3, r.Position.Z)
            Global.rootpart1 = r
            Global.rootpart = r
            Global.head = c:FindFirstChild("Head") or r
            Global.torso = c:FindFirstChild("Torso") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or r
        end
    end)

    print("[Axirian] Loaded: "..effectName.." | Music: "..musicKey)
end

function swait(num)
if num==0 or num==nil then

end

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

dd=rus.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
if not scriptfolder:FindFirstChild("PyroplexAssets") then
dd:Disconnect()
return
end
local root=rootpart1
TweenFunction(Floor,.01,"pos",v3(root.Position.X,root.Position.Y+1,root.Position.Z)):Play()
sine=os.clock()
pcall(function() 
for _,h in scriptfolder.Parent:GetDescendants() do 
if h:IsA("PointLight") then
h.Brightness=5+sound.PlaybackLoudness/50
h.Range=3+sound.PlaybackLoudness/60
h.Color=rgb(193+sound.PlaybackLoudness/75,83+sound.PlaybackLoudness/25,0)
end
end

for _,h in scriptfolder.Parent:GetDescendants() do 
if h:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v.Name=="MainColor" then
h.Brightness=1.5+sound.PlaybackLoudness/50
h.LightEmission=-50
end

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

local PoityLight=i("PointLight",FloorAttachment)


local upto=1 
local hfg 
hfg=rus.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
if not scriptfolder:FindFirstChild("ScourgeAssets") then 
hfg:Disconnect()
end

upto+=1
local root=rootpart1
TweenFunction(Floor,.055,"pos",v3(root.Position.X,root.Position.Y-1,root.Position.Z)):Play()

for _,v in foldah:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v.Color~=cs({csk(0,c3()),csk(1,c3())}) and v.Color~=cs({csk(0,c3(1,1,1)),csk(1,c3(1,1,1))}) then 
v.Color=cs({
  csk(0,rgb(100+sound.PlaybackLoudness/5,0,0)),
  csk(1,rgb(100+sound.PlaybackLoudness/5,0,0))
})
end
end
for _,v in foldah:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("PointLight") then 
v.Brightness=5+sound.PlaybackLoudness/50
v.Range=2+sound.PlaybackLoudness/25
v.Color=rgb(0+sound.PlaybackLoudness/7,0,0)
end
end
for _,v in foldah:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v.Name=="Decal" then
v.Orientation="FacingCamera"
end
end

local forward=root.CFrame.LookVector
local up=Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local front=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position + forward,up)
local Offset=CFrame.new(-25+2.5*sin(upto/55),20-1*sin(upto/40),20)
local Offset1=CFrame.new(25-2.5*sin(upto/50),20-1*sin(upto/45),20)
local Offset2=CFrame.new(0+2.5*sin(upto/70),20-1*sin(upto/50),20)
local tilt=CFrame.Angles(rad(85-7.5*sin(upto/55)),rad(0),rad(20))

end)

    end)

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

if num==0 or num==nil then
game:service'RunService'.Stepped:wait(0)

game:service'RunService'.Stepped:wait(0)
end
end

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

local Global=(getgenv and getgenv()) or shared

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

local count=1
local amount=15
local Radius=20
for i=1,amount do 
local rclone=LargeShardAttachment:Clone()
count+=1 
rclone.Parent=partatt1
local angle=4.8*count*5
rclone.CFrame=rclone.CFrame*angles(rad(0), rad(angle),rad(0))*cf(-20,0,0)
end 

for _,v in partatt:GetDescendants() do 
if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then 
v.Orientation="VelocityPerpendicular"
end
end
for _,v in partatt1:GetDescendants() do 
if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v.Name=="star" then 
v.ZOffset=10
v.Orientation="FacingCamera"
end
end
for _,v in container:GetDescendants() do 
if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then 
v.LockedToPart=true
end
end
for _,v in ring:GetDescendants() do 
if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v.Name~="Star1" and v.Name~="Star2" and v.Name~="Middle" and v.Name~="Symbol" then 
v.Orientation="VelocityPerpendicular"
end
end

local b 
local upd=1
b=rus.PostSimulation:Connect(function()
if not scriptfolder:FindFirstChild("VibranceAssets")then
b:Disconnect()
end
upd+=1
local model=scriptfolder:FindFirstChild("VibranceAssets")
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
pcall(function()
if model then
local Torso=rootpart1
local floor=model:FindFirstChild("Floor")
local floor1=model:FindFirstChild("Floor2")
local ring=model:FindFirstChild("Rings")
local root=rootpart1
TweenFunction(floor,.1,"pos",v3(root.Position.X,root.Position.Y-1,root.Position.Z)):Play()
TweenFunction(floor1,.1,"pos",v3(root.Position.X,root.Position.Y-1,root.Position.Z)):Play()
local forward=root.CFrame.LookVector
local up=Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local front=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position + forward,up)
local Offset=CFrame.new(0+3.5*sin(upd/40), 18.5-2.5*sin(upd/30), 7-2.75*sin(upd/28.5))
local tilt=CFrame.Angles(rad(25-5.5*sin(upd/40.5)), 0, rad(5+7.5*sin(upd/45.25)))
local rotation=CFrame.Angles(0, rad(upd/2.5+sound.PlaybackLoudness/100), 0)
ring.CFrame=ring.CFrame:Lerp(front*Offset*tilt*rotation,.1)
floor.Rotation=v3(0,upd+sound.PlaybackLoudness/500,0)
floor1.Rotation=v3(0,upd+sound.PlaybackLoudness/500,0)
for _,v in container:GetDescendants() do 
if v:IsA("PointLight") then 
v.Brightness=5+sound.PlaybackLoudness/50
v.Range=2+sound.PlaybackLoudness/25

end)
end)


end

    end)

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

game:service'RunService'.Stepped:wait(0)

end

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end


end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end

local Global=(getgenv and getgenv()) or shared
local Flooring=Global.Flooring
function swait(num)
if num==0 or num==nil then
game:service'RunService'.Stepped:wait(0)
else
for i=0,num do
game:service'RunService'.Stepped:wait(0)
end
end
end
local scriptfolder=Global.Cont
local sound=Global.Loud
local im2=Global.im2
local MusicPlayer=Global.MusicPlayer
local rootpart1=Global.rootpart1
local rootpart=Global.rootpart
local insSet=Global.insSet
local head=Global.head
function TweenFunction(obj, speed,whattype, anim)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
if whattype =="pos" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Position=anim})
elseif whattype =="size" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Size=anim})
elseif whattype =="bt" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{BackgroundTransparency=anim})
elseif whattype =="trans" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Transparency=anim})
elseif whattype=="rot" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Rotation=anim})
elseif whattype=="brightness" then
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,{Brightness=anim})
end
end
function BetterTween(obj, speed, prop)
local Tinfo=TweenInfo.new
local TweenService=game.TweenService
local hii=Tinfo(speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
return TweenService:Create(obj, hii,prop)

end

local currentIndex = 0
local isSwitching = false

local function loadEffect(index)
    if isSwitching then return end
    isSwitching = true
    local name = EFFECT_ORDER[index]
    print("[Axirian] Switching -> "..name.." ("..tostring(index).."/"..tostring(#EFFECT_ORDER)..")")
    setupGlobalsAndAudio(MUSIC[name], name)
    task.wait(0.05)
    local runner = EffectRunners[name]
    if runner then
        runner()
    else
        warn("[Axirian] missing runner "..name)
    end
    currentIndex = index
    isSwitching = false
    print("[Axirian] ACTIVE: "..name.." | Press V to cycle")
end

task.defer(function()
    task.wait(0.25)
    loadEffect(1)
end)

local function onV()
    local nextIdx = (currentIndex % #EFFECT_ORDER) + 1
    loadEffect(nextIdx)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
        onV()
    end
end)

pcall(function()
    game:GetService("ContextActionService"):BindAction(
        "AxirianCycleV",
        function(_, state)
            if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then onV() end
            return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
        end,
        false,
        Enum.KeyCode.V
    )
end)

print("[Axirian] Multi-loader v3 READY. Press V to cycle.")
print("[Axirian] "..table.concat(EFFECT_ORDER, " -> "))
